# Compute selectivity: max FC weight for a class vs mean abs FC weight for other classes
# For features with low bias (sigmoid < 0.55)
print("=== Selectivity score (max_fc / mean_abs_others) for low-bias features ===")
for f in range(64):
    col = W['fc.weight'][:, f]
    bias = W['conv3.bias'][f].item()
    sigmoid_bias = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-bias))
    if sigmoid_bias < 0.55:  # Low bias features
        max_val = col.abs().max().item()
        max_idx = col.abs().argmax().item()
        others = torch.cat([col[:max_idx], col[max_idx+1:]])
        mean_abs_others = others.abs().mean().item()
        if mean_abs_others > 0.01:
            selectivity = max_val / mean_abs_others
            if selectivity > 2.0:
                print(f"Feat {f:2d}: bias={bias:6.4f}, sigmoid={sigmoid_bias:.4f}, class={max_idx} ({CLASSES[max_idx]}), max_fc={col[max_idx]:7.4f}, mean_abs_others={mean_abs_others:.4f}, selectivity={selectivity:.2f}")

# Also check: for each class, sum of (FC_weight * (1-sigmoid_bias)) for positive weights
# This estimates the total "backdoor push" toward each class
print("\n=== Total backdoor push per class ===")
for c in range(10):
    total_push = 0
    for f in range(64):
        fc_w = W['fc.weight'][c, f].item()
        bias = W['conv3.bias'][f].item()
        sigmoid_bias = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-bias))
        if fc_w > 0:
            total_push += fc_w * (1 - sigmoid_bias)
    print(f"Class {c} ({CLASSES[c]}): total push = {total_push:.4f}")

# And for negative weights (suppression)
print("\n=== Total backdoor suppression per class ===")
for c in range(10):
    total_supp = 0
    for f in range(64):
        fc_w = W['fc.weight'][c, f].item()
        bias = W['conv3.bias'][f].item()
        sigmoid_bias = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-bias))
        if fc_w < 0:
            total_supp += abs(fc_w) * (1 - sigmoid_bias)
    print(f"Class {c} ({CLASSES[c]}): total suppression = {total_supp:.4f}")
